Subject: 3-star review draft

I’m a mobile dog groomer in Halifax, and Harbourline fitted out my 2021 Transit with a grooming tub and ramp, water tanks, heater, flooring and cabinetry.

The tub and ramp are honestly the best part of the van. Dogs can walk right in, which makes my work easier, and Moose handled the leak incident with considerably more grace than I did. He sat in the tub through the whole flood like a king while I was the one screaming.

On October 27, a fitting on the hot-water line let go during a groom. There was water across the floor and into a cabinet, and I had to towel off the dog and send him home half-finished. I cancelled the rest of that day’s appointments, and the van was off the road until November 6. I lost six bookings in the meantime, on top of the rest of that day.

What upset me most wasn’t that a part failed. Stuff breaks. It was being told at first that it was probably user error and wouldn’t be covered. After the van was looked at, Glenn said the outlet’s compression fitting was a cheaper one his supplier had substituted, took responsibility, replaced the hot-side fittings and refunded the $180 diagnostic fee.

I appreciate that he owned the issue in the end and made it right on that fee. The delay and the initial response were still frustrating, especially when my van is how I earn a living. I’d recommend that other groomers or tradespeople considering a fitout get warranty terms and any coverage for parts or repairs clearly in writing.

Overall, I’m happy with the tub and ramp, but the repair experience took a shine off the rest. Three stars.
